smyx-reptile-tail-loss-detection-analysis v1.0.2

- Adds AI-powered periodic visual analysis of gecko and lizard tails for early detection of tail loss, wounds, and abnormal shortening using enclosure cameras.
- Compares current tail length to historical measurements and species-specific body-length ratios, triggering alerts if significant loss or fresh wounds are detected.
- Classifies tail-tip conditions (e.g., intact, amputated, scabbed, regenerated) and recognizes context (shedding, cohabitation, stress, image quality) to minimize false positives.
- Enforces strict open-id (user identity) verification before analysis and mandates cloud-based query for historical reports.
- Provides a structured, multi-level alert system for keepers with actionable recommendations, designed for integration into vivarium camera systems.
- Clear constraints prevent overstepping into medical advice and require high image quality for reliable results.
